name: ai-proposal-writer-anna
tagline: Enterprise AI Proposal Workspace: Pipeline CRM, Telemetry Heatmap & CPQ for Agencies.
description:
AI Proposal Writer is a comprehensive, enterprise-grade AI proposal creation, quality assurance, and deal management workspace purpose-built for digital agencies, consultancies, freelance developers, and creative studios.

Transform unstructured client briefs into high-converting, professionally formatted proposals with Anna's native AI sampling, deterministic CPQ pricing, real-time client engagement telemetry, Kanban deal pipeline, and reusable content libraries.

### Enterprise Capabilities & Advanced Lifecycle

1. Deal Pipeline CRM & Kanban Board:
- Switch seamlessly between Table View and Visual Kanban Pipeline (Drafting, Internal Review, Sent, Won/Accepted, Declined, Archived).
- Real-time pipeline revenue aggregation, win rate telemetry, deal size averages, and one-click stage progression.

2. Client Engagement Telemetry & Reading Heatmap:
- Track client document engagement: total opens, unique session count, reading duration, and last viewed timestamps.
- Section Reading Heatmap: visual attention breakdown revealing where clients focus their attention.

3. Reusable Content Library & Block Vault:
- Modular vault with pre-approved agency blocks: Enterprise Case Studies, SOC2/GDPR Compliance, Agile Sprint Cadence, 90-Day Hypercare SLAs, Cloud Blueprints, and Commercial Escrow.
- 1-click 'Save to Library' and 'Insert into Proposal' workflows.

4. Visual Version Diff & Changelog Inspector:
- Compare any two revision snapshots with visual text additions/removals, commercial value shifts, and section modifications.

5. Proposal Security & Confidentiality Gate:
- Set client passcodes/PINs, mandatory Mutual NDA acceptance gates, and 'CONFIDENTIAL' watermark banners.

6. Quantitative ROI & Payback Engine:
- Model client ROI, monthly hours saved, annual operational savings, and payback period in months.

7. Multi-Format Export Suite:
- High-fidelity branded PDF with dynamic Table of Contents and dual sign-off blocks.
- Standalone responsive HTML Pitch Deck for offline client presentation.
- Clean GitHub-flavored Markdown (.md) export.
